assertions.title: Query iterators generated by macro
assertions.evidence: All 101 unit tests pass (exit code 0). The query module at katla_ecs/src/query/ contains only two files: mod.rs and macros.rs — no individual iterN.rs files remain. macros.rs defines four declarative macro families (impl_query_iter_arity1!, impl_query_iter_all_ref!, impl_query_iter_single_mut!, impl_query_iter_double_mut!) that generate all mutability permutations for arities 1-8. mod.rs contains only macro invocations organized by arity. Adding arity 9 would require only one-line macro invocations per permutation (documented in a comment at the bottom of mod.rs). The `as *mut ComponentStorageManager` cast appears only in the centralized `borrow_ptr()` helper in storage.rs (line 361) and in two test functions within storage.rs (lines 536, 551). Zero instances exist outside storage.rs.

commandsRun.observation: Only mod.rs and macros.rs — no iterN.rs files
3 matches: storage.rs:361 (centralized borrow_ptr helper), storage.rs:536 (test), storage.rs:551 (test). Zero outside storage.rs.
